parsed.summary: The patch addresses the ordering issue in RelatedFieldListFilter and RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new behavior where RelatedFieldListFilter falls back to the ordering defined in the related model's Meta.ordering field. This may break existing behavior where the ordering was not defined or was different.
